en.headline: Hui leaves Monday night for Italy metals conference
en.dek: The financial services secretary will attend a precious metals meeting in Sorrento and visit Swiss gold refineries before returning on Thursday.
body: Secretary for Financial Services and the Treasury Christopher Hui will leave on Monday night for Italy and Switzerland, the government itinerary reported by RTHK said.

He is due to attend the Global Precious Metals Conference 2026 in Sorrento, then visit several refineries in Switzerland that refine gold to international standards. The chief executive of Hong Kong Precious Metals Central Clearing Limited will travel with him.
Hui is scheduled to return to Hong Kong on Thursday, 8 October. The Under Secretary for Financial Services and the Treasury will act as secretary while he is away.

zh.headline: 許正宇周一晚出發 赴意大利出席貴金屬會議
zh.dek: 財庫局局長將到索倫托出席全球貴金屬會議，並到瑞士參觀黃金精煉廠，周四返港。
body: 財經事務及庫務局局長許正宇將於周一晚啓程前往意大利及瑞士。港台引述當局行程報道。
他會在索倫托出席全球貴金屬會議2026，其後到瑞士參觀數家按國際標準精煉黃金的精煉廠。香港貴金屬中央結算系統有限公司行政總裁將會同行。
許正宇預定周四（8日）返港。離港期間，由財經事務及庫務局副局長署任局長職務。
